about: Rev3.0 GlassFront carrier frame 'Frame GF', native parametric Fusion 360 part, stage 1 (frame) + stage 2 Part A (cell-corner fix) + stage 3 GF-1.1 (counterbores, boss coring, H6 cell, tail pocket, corner radii, F5-F8 blend). Built by Design Reports/Rev3.0/tools/glassfront/fusion/NN_*.py from the master Mechanical/Rev3.0_GlassFront/Rev3.0_GlassFront_params.json (GF-1.0). Units mm / deg; plan coordinates abs KiCad (x, y down); model X = x, Y = -y, Z = 0 at the PCB back, -Z to the oven front.
master_revision: GF-1.1 (2026-11-15: GF-1.0 + stage-3 batch items 1-8 from the Fusion fit findings F1 / F2 and the CadQuery verification; see change_log)

document.version_note: frame geometry last changed in v13 (GF-1.1 lead round 2, counterbore 7.4 x 9.0); v10 first GF-1.1 build, v11 / v12 parameter comment only

versions.10: GF-1.1 geometry (stage 3, 48-56) - saved by 59, all exports taken from it
versions.11: GF-1.1: comment of user parameter cb_floor corrected (61, documentation only)
versions.12: identical to v11: the MCP executed the top-level wrapper of 61 twice (second save without changes)
versions.13: GF-1.1 lead round 2: counterbore cb_w 7.4 x cb_l 9.0 (62); saved by 59 (MSG round 2), every export (frame STEP / STL, assembly STEP, glass STEP, .f3d) taken from it

exports.step: Mechanical/Rev3.0_GlassFront/Rev3.0_GlassFront_Frame.step (component 'Frame GF', 1 solid, 922 faces; exported from v13 by 59 = 25 verbatim)
exports.renders: Mechanical/Rev3.0_GlassFront/renders/Fusion_FrameGF_*.png (regenerated for GF-1.1 by 45) and Fusion_GF11_*.png (58); GF11_thickness_map_verify_toolchain.png (verification thickness map of the exported STEP)

stage2_partA.fix_H6: the R2 cell corner (cell_r) is moved down the left wall and blended into the boss: arc tangent to the cell's left wall, centre (XL + cell_r, h6_fill_y), crossing the boss at 90 deg on the cell floor (circle orthogonal to the boss circle: h6_fill_y = h6_y + sqrt(cell_r^2 + r_boss_floor^2 - (h6_x - XL - cell_r)^2) = 127.153 at default, 127.168 at t_opt 1.0); a vertical line x = XL + cell_r inside the boss closes the profile. Done in the 'Corner cells sketch' (same profile, same 1 deg taper, so the arc stays tangent to the wall at every Z). flange_to_counterbore_wall_worst_positio.note: the same minimum at every extreme position (slot and counterbore are offsets of the same stadium segment); ~0.15 at the opening, the minimum sits at the flange top edge where the 1 deg wall draft and the R0.3 floor round close in
